reason: I can't take a 12-month, roughly PHP 960,000 commitment to the board for a company with zero customer results. A simulation is only as good as its track record, and nobody has shown me theirs.
objection: How do I know the simulated shoppers behave like my real shoppers? If the model is wrong, I've paid to move shelves the wrong way, and I'm the one who recommended it.
would_change_my_mind: A short paid or free pilot on a few of our stores with no 12-month lock-in, where their predicted lift is checked against our real control stores before any contract.
